summary: Date-signal path was whole-run either/or instead of per-table mixed-source. Strategy §3.2/§5 require per-table fallback to DAO LastUpdated when COM is unavailable OR when a table has no DateTime columns.
fix: CleanupAnalyser.Run now takes an optional primaryDateSampler (COM) plus the required fallback (IR LastUpdated). Per-table selection: COM if table has DateTime columns AND COM produced a sample; otherwise DAO LastUpdated. CLI wires both.

summary: VBA DoCmd.OpenForm/OpenReport/OpenQuery/OpenMacro/RunMacro parsing missing. Form/report names appearing as bare tokens in other modules' VBA also not counted as VbaReference. Both produce false-positive Low-confidence findings.
fix: Added regex parsing for DoCmd.Open*/RunMacro in all VBA blobs (modules + form/report code-behind). Added bare-token presence scanning for form/report/module names across modules with self-reference owner-name exclusion. Filtered DCount/OpenRecordset targets to known object names.

summary: Event-property binding (On*/Before*/After*) treated bare identifiers matching forms/reports/queries as NavigationEdge. Strategy §3.3.2 restricts this to macro identifiers only.
fix: Narrowed CollectEventPropertyBindings to macro names only.

summary: matchedSubstring stored only the token (`OLD`) instead of the boundary-bearing substring (`_OLD`) per strategy §3.1.6/§5 schema example. Medium-tier explanation used the Category name instead of the matched substring.
fix: Replaced Groups[1].Value with TrimTrailingBoundary(match.Value) for all four regex-based categories so the leading boundary char is preserved. BuildExplanation now uses MatchedSubstring.

summary: Missing tests for the §3.2 mixed-source path, VBA DoCmd.Open*/RunMacro/DCount, and bare-token form references.
fix: Added 9 hermetic tests covering all the above paths + negative tests for the narrowed event-property scope.

summary: CLI did not gracefully degrade on COM activation/open failure. Strategy §3.2 requires automatic fallback to DAO LastUpdated when COM throws.
fix: Extracted ComDateMaximaProbe helper that runs sampler-factory + Sample() in try/catch and returns either primary sampler or a degradation note. CLI consumes the result, prints a stderr warning, and prepends note to findings.DegradationNotes. 5 new hermetic tests in ComDateMaximaProbeTests cover all branches.

summary: REGRESSION introduced by R1 fix: new generic-properties branch placed before the type==Begin branch, consuming Begin macro-action nodes as generic controls and silently breaking IrFormOrReport.MacroActions population for form/report embedded macro actions.
fix: Reordered WalkChildren so type==Begin is checked BEFORE the generic catch-all. Added 2 hermetic regression tests in tests/AccessHarvester.Pipeline.Tests/UsageIdentification/IrLoaderTests.cs covering embedded Begin-action capture + generic-control walk.

summary: Module/class bare-token VBA scan was over-broad. Strategy §3.3 restricts module/class evidence to Call / Set ... New / qualifying namespace contexts.
fix: New ScanModuleContextPresence uses three context-specific regexes per module name (Call, Set...New, qualifier dot-access). Form/report bare-token scan kept per §3.3.3 matrix. 4 hermetic tests cover all three contexts + a comment/string-literal negative.

summary: No hermetic test for RowSource-based references (§3.3.1 inline-SQL parsing on controls).
fix: Added 2 hermetic tests for RowSource: literal table name + inline SELECT FROM tblTarget.

summary: CLI did not print usage message when both --in and --manifest were supplied (only printed an error). Strategy §8 requires usage text on both supplied AND neither supplied.
fix: Added PrintUsage() call before return 2 in the dual-flag branch.

summary: COM-failure degradation note (Per-table date signals fell back to DAO LastUpdated.) could contradict the analyser's Date sampling unavailable note when no IR LastUpdated values exist.
fix: Made the probe-note prepend conditional on findings.DateSignalSource != 'unavailable'. When DAO fallback also produced no findings, the analyser's own note stands alone and the probe message is suppressed.
